in_sanskrit.name: Ethyana
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of fertility
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ethyana एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ethya' meaning fertility and 'An' meaning mother, Ethyana represents the goddess of fertility and motherhood in Hindu mythology. This name holds a deep significance for Hindu families and is often given to girls born in the auspicious Hindu lunar month of Shukla Paksha (bright fortnight), especially during the Harvest Festival season.
